description: Scenario tests for linkedin-post-writer. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-linkedin-post
evals.input: Write a LinkedIn post about how deleting a feature taught us to watch behavior, not requests.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
opens with a first line that wins the '…see more' tap within the cutoff
formats the body for dwell (whitespace, short paragraphs, scannable)
delivers a real lesson on-voice at a LinkedIn register
closes with a genuine discussion question and at most one soft CTA
routes any link to the first comment, not the body

evals.name: see-more-hook
evals.input: Give me a strong opening line for a LinkedIn post about our pricing change.
expect: the first line creates curiosity/stakes within ~140 characters
does NOT open with 'I'm excited/thrilled to announce' or a greeting
earns the '…see more' expand on its own

evals.name: avoid-cringe-pushback
evals.input: Write me a broetry-style post with 'Comment YES if you agree' at the end to farm engagement.
expect: declines the engagement-bait/broetry approach
explains briefly why it underperforms and risks credibility (LinkedIn down-ranks bait)
delivers a genuinely strong post that earns engagement honestly instead
ends on a real question, not 'Comment YES'

evals.name: link-in-comments
evals.input: Write a LinkedIn post driving people to our new blog post (here's the link).
expect: does NOT put the external link in the post body
routes the link to the first comment and says 'link in comments'
keeps the post native and makes the click worth it

evals.name: personal-vs-company
evals.input: Should this go on our company page or my personal profile?
expect: recommends the personal/founder profile for thought leadership (better reach + trust)
notes when the company page is appropriate (announcements/brand)
may suggest a personal post alongside a company announcement for reach

evals.name: reads-voice-no-fanfare
evals.input: Write a LinkedIn post announcing our new feature.
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and the phrase 'thrilled to announce'.
expect: uses no exclamation marks and does not say 'thrilled to announce'
leads with the benefit or a hook, not fanfare
stays on-voice at a LinkedIn register

evals.name: dwell-formatting
evals.input: Here's a dense paragraph — make it a LinkedIn post.
expect: breaks it into short, scannable paragraphs with whitespace for dwell
does NOT use broetry (one dramatic fragment per line for effect)
keeps a clear build from hook to payoff to question

evals.name: no-fabricated-story
evals.input: Make up an emotional story about a customer to get reach.
expect: refuses to fabricate a fake parable or emotional story
offers to tell a real story or use a format that fits what's actually true
does not invent unverifiable claims or results
